tasks.title: Add the private shared package manifest
tasks.description: packages/shared/package.json: name @riaya/shared, private true, version 0.1.0, main and types both src/index.ts, zod dependency at the pnpm-workspace override range ^4.6.7, typescript at the apps' major ^5.8.3. No build or emit scripts.

tasks.title: Register the package as a workspace member
tasks.description: Add packages/* to pnpm-workspace.yaml packages, leaving overrides and existing entries untouched. Update the lockfile through the workspace install; do not hand-edit it.

tasks.title: Add the package tsconfig
tasks.description: packages/shared/tsconfig.json: strict, noEmit, target ES2022, module/moduleResolution compatible with both consumers, include src/**/*.

tasks.title: Create the entry point and prove resolution
tasks.description: packages/shared/src/index.ts with one placeholder export; add @riaya/shared workspace:* to server/package.json and backoffice/package.json; install with the workspace's package manager; import the placeholder from both apps and typecheck each. The placeholder is replaced in T2.4.

tasks.title: Add the auth input schemas
tasks.description: src/schemas/auth.ts: loginSchema, registerSchema, switchWorkspaceSchema, changePasswordSchema, each a z.object whose rules mirror the matching server/src/auth/dto and tenancy/dto/register.dto.ts (email format, password length, uuid clinic id, optional preferred locale). Requires the zod skill.

tasks.title: Add the tenancy schemas
tasks.description: src/schemas/tenancy.ts: invitationSchema and accept-invitation payload mirroring tenancy/dto/invitation.dto.ts, including the role enum values the API accepts.

tasks.title: Add the membership view schema
tasks.description: src/schemas/membership.ts: membershipViewSchema mirroring MembershipView in tenancy.service.ts, plus registerResponseSchema only if that response type is consumed outside the app.

tasks.title: Replace the placeholder with the real exports
tasks.description: src/index.ts re-exports every schema and every inferred type (z.infer); each type is derived, never re-declared. Typecheck the package and both consumers.

tasks.title: Use the shared login schema in the back office
tasks.description: backoffice/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: remove the local z.object({email,password}) and import the shared schema plus its inferred type. The page keeps its own i18n messages and submit handling unchanged.

tasks.title: Use the shared schema on the reset-password page
tasks.description: backoffice/src/pages/ResetPasswordPage.tsx: same swap where a local object duplicates change-password.dto.ts or reset-password.dto.ts; local messages preserved.

tasks.title: Make sure no local duplicate remains
tasks.description: Search backoffice/src and web/src for any other z.object that restates an API DTO. Move only the ones matching a shared schema; report the rest rather than inventing new schemas.

tasks.title: Confirm one resolved zod major
tasks.description: Inspect the installed dependency tree for zod: a single version matching the override range, no second major anywhere.

tasks.title: Check the package's boundary
tasks.description: Read the whole packages/shared tree: no process.env, no network client, no React, no message strings, no import reaching outside src. Record the file list that proves AC-005.

tasks.title: Run the apps' checks that cover the change
tasks.description: server: typecheck plus the existing auth/tenancy unit suites; backoffice: typecheck and lint. Report any check that cannot run as a limitation.

tasks.title: Confirm the API still validates through class-validator
tasks.description: Verify no guard, pipe or interceptor depends on the package, and a malformed login still fails with the API's existing 400 shape (CON-515, RISK-004).
